content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The recruitment notice specifies the distribution of the 2 Assistant Professor posts across two departments at Kumari Devi Choubey College of Agriculture and Research Station, Saja.

content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the IGKV Assistant Professor recruitment must meet the academic standards prescribed by the university.

rows.post: Assistant Professor (Genetics & Plant Breeding and Plant Pathology)
rows.qualification_required: 1. Master degree in the relevant subject of Agricultural faculty with least 55% marks (or equivalent grade 6.50 10.00 scales) with good academic record.2. For candidates having Master degree, NET (National Eligibility Test) shall remain compulsory along with one publication in NAAS (National Academy of Agricultural Science, New Delhi) related referred journal for recruitment to the post of Assistant Professor and equivalent in the disciplines in which NET is conducted. Essentiality of NET can be waived off for the candidates holding Ph.D. degree provided it has been done with course work as prescribed by the UGC Regulation 2009 and the candidate has at least two full length publication having a NAAS rating not less than the 4, on the last date of submission of course work will not qualify for NET exemption.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive honorarium as per new recommendation of VV order क्रमांक/स्था-04/नस्ती क-49/2022/2731/रायपुर, दिनांक 01/08/2022. The appointment of the Guest Teacher / Part Time Teacher is contractual for one academic session or till the appointment of regular teacher, whichever is earlier. If eligible candidates are not available as mentioned, in extreme cases under exigency, PG candidates may be considered for part time teacher on period basis for only one semester after approval of competent authority.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IGKV Assistant Professor
content_sections.text: Download the application form and read all instructions carefully from the official notification. Fill out the application form completely with correct details. Affix a self-attested passport-size photograph on the designated space of the application form. Attach self-attested photocopies of certificates, relevant documents of experience, and publication details. Send the duly filled application form along with all enclosures via email to [email protected] on or before 22 October 2026 by 11:59 PM. Attend the walk-in interview on 27 October 2026 starting from 11:00 AM onwards at the College of Agriculture, Raipur, bringing all original documents for verification.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form Self-attested passport-size photograph affixed on the application Certificates and mark sheets of educational qualifications (High School, Intermediate, Bachelors, Masters, Doctoral) NET certificate (if applicable) Experience certificates (if applicable) Publications list and reprints All original documents for verification during the interview

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications shall be rejected. The post of Guest Teacher / Part Time Teacher is purely temporary, and selected candidates have no right to claim for regular appointment on any post as advertised by Indira Gandhi Krishi Vishwavidyalaya. If the performance of selected candidate is found unsatisfactory, services can be withdrawn by giving one week notice. No TA/DA will be provided to candidates for appearing in the interview. Maximum age limit is 40 years, with 5 years relaxation given for SC, ST, OBC, and women candidates as per Chhattisgarh Government rules. Candidates must bring all original documents on the date of interview, failing which they will not be eligible to appear. After selection by the committee, candidates must submit an affidavit on stamp paper of 50/- as per format to agree to the terms and conditions prescribed by the university.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in IGKV Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies are available for Assistant Professor in Genetics & Plant Breeding (1 post) and Plant Pathology (1 post).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date and time for submission of application is 22 October 2026 up to 11:59 PM by email.

faq.question: Q3. When and where is the interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The interview is scheduled for 27 October 2026 from 11:00 AM onwards at the College of Agriculture, Raipur.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Master's degree in the relevant subject of Agricultural faculty with at least 55% marks (or equivalent grade) and possess NET qualification or fulfill Ph.D. exemption criteria as per UGC regulations.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 40 years, with a 5-year relaxation for SC, ST, OBC, and women candidates as per Chhattisgarh Government rules.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. Are these positions permanent?
faq.answer: No, these positions are purely temporary and contractual for one academic session or until the appointment of a regular teacher, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q8. Where should candidates send their applications?
faq.answer: Candidates must send their applications via email to [email protected].
